metadata.stop_condition: min 50000 iterations OR 5 seconds CPU time (first met wins) and at least 1 second(s) of CPU time
metadata.warmup_policy_detail: chunks of 2000 iterations; at least 100000 iterations and 20 second(s), whichever comes later, then stop once JIT compilation stays below 2% of chunk wall time for 5 consecutive chunks and 1 second(s); cap 2x the floor
metadata.transport: smithy-java HttpClient (SmithyHttpClientTransport), HTTP/1.1 over TLS 1.3 to a loopback fixture server in a child JVM; certificate verification disabled (self-signed)
metadata.http_mock: none: real HTTP client over TLS to a loopback fixture server in another process
